recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future chromosome/cytoband terminology work should proceed through current Clinical Genomics MolecularDefinition terminology discussions, not by resurrecting retired Observation genetics chromosome content.
issue_request: FHIR-8030 was a Published/Persuasive request against old Observation genetics chromosome content. It objected to narrow chromosome values and recorded a resolution to use an NCBI-style chromosome value set, with NC_000007 as the example identifier.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-8030 source commit was found. Historical release content shows chromosome-human used as an example binding for Sequence/MolecularSequence chromosome fields, commit 33b409a4b6 added chromosome-human CodeSystem and ValueSet source files, and a 2022 Jira comment noted the spec pointed to the R4 chromosome-human value set.
additional_context: Later core history removed the relevant old artifacts: 3cfe12f1b4 removed outdated clinical genomics Observation artifacts and d4613dfa1c removed chromosome-human CodeSystem/ValueSet as unused during MolecularSequence simplification. Current fhir.ini comments out MolecularSequence and makes MolecularDefinition active; MolecularDefinition's cytoband chromosome element is an unbound CodeableConcept. Later FHIR-50250 resolved No Change on adding a MolecularDefinition chromosome binding while location structure and value-set needs remain unsettled.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing chromosome-human or binding the current MolecularDefinition chromosome element would conflict with the later removal history and the later Clinical Genomics no-change decision.

related_jiras.note: Resolved No Change on adding a chromosome binding to MolecularDefinition.location.cytobandLocation.cytobandInterval.chromosome, supporting the current unbound CodeableConcept.
Later terminology maintenance mentions chromosome-human in THO, confirming it is terminology content rather than an active core source artifact for this reconciliation.
